g.text: Existing-law strength sweep: exploratory organization readouts
Positive input mean and fluctuation amplitude scale together; each model keeps its native law and three original sizes.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d5b64

g.text: Native status observed 2026-10-19 18:55:13 UTC: running · 229/256 new outputs · 0 failures
New levels: two-seed target (exploratory). Original 0.001/0.01: twelve seeds. Whiskers show observed seed range, not confidence intervals.
Regions: connected arcs above current minimum + half current contrast. Dashed occupancy also requires contrast ≥10% of own basal contrast.
Filled circles: complete n=2; squares: n=12. Open data markers: partial n=1; open markers below occupancy panels: no noisy path available.
Full windows: chemical 0–32000 (cadence 5); Spring 0–3200 (cadence 0.5). Connecting segments guide the eye. Native units are not calibrated across models.
